source: Independent hand-picked visual material labels on runtime-trimmed sprites; samples are not generated from polygons.
policy: Full visible solid rock/wood/building body, plants excluded. Trees retain trunk/root collision and overhead canopy passage. Gate opening passable.

cabin.note: Complete solid cabin: chimney, roof, both walls, closed door and both steps. There is no indoor scene. Outer decorative foliage stays passable.

prop_0.note: Same complete closed cabin silhouette as cabin; no wall-only footprint.

prop_1.note: Whole three-log pile, including upper timber and both rounded cut faces; excludes foliage.

prop_2.note: Long log pile full silhouette; each timber and exposed circular cut end is blocked.

prop_3.note: Whole barrel, lid to rounded belly and bottom rim; no side entry through upper volume.

prop_4.note: Full crate boards and uprights with hand-authored oblique edges; outside foliage excluded.

prop_5.note: Grey crate full body and top contour, separate from prop_4 silhouette.

bench.note: Whole workbench top, rear post, apron, supporting beam and legs. Small side vegetation and below-beam gap remain open.

stump_0.note: Entire visible woody stump, cut top, bark, and all long irregular roots; leaves outside wood excluded.

stump_1.note: Whole broken stump including high splintered bark and both protruding lateral roots.

ore_0.note: Two complete exposed ore rocks, including upper peaks and side faces; leafy exterior excluded.

ore_1.note: Complete tall ore peak and independent foreground stone, no thin lower-foot-only barriers.

ore_2.note: Full broad ore mound and foreground stone; grey material counts as solid at every height.

gate.note: Both complete irregular masonry sides and individual foot rocks. The central arch opening stays traversable; overhead greenery is not a solid.

pond_0_rocks.note: Seven independently drawn shore-rock solids: top, upper-right small, upper-right large, left small, left low, bottom small, bottom-right. Separate from retained water.

pond_1_rocks.note: Five separate complete visible shore rocks. Each upper/side face and each tiny stone is solid; green bank remains passable.

pond_2_rocks.note: Three large bank rocks plus both small water stones have distinct solids. Entire visible grey rock, not just lower base, is blocked.

resource_rock_0.note: Complete collectible main boulder and small foreground stone; visible solid upper faces now covered.

resource_rock_1.note: Complete tall grey collectible stone and its separate lower foreground stone.

resource_rock_2.note: Full broad collectible grey rocks, including the peak, shoulder, and foreground stone.

resource_rock_spent_0.note: Three independently outlined remaining solid stones; removed decorative foliage and retained actual stone gaps.

resource_rock_spent_1.note: Both full visible depleted stones rather than cropped lower contact patches.

resource_rock_spent_2.note: Three complete surviving stones, separately traced with open surrounding green ground.

tree_0.note: Original measured root footprint and unchanged root depth, plus independently traced visible wood: trunk, exposed fork and large branches. Foliage canopy and empty gaps remain passable; no whole-canopy collision.

tree_1.note: Original measured root footprint and unchanged root depth, plus independently traced visible wood: trunk, exposed fork and large branches. Foliage canopy and empty gaps remain passable; no whole-canopy collision.

tree_2.note: Original measured root footprint and unchanged root depth, plus independently traced visible wood: trunk, exposed fork and large branches. Foliage canopy and empty gaps remain passable; no whole-canopy collision.

tree_3.note: Original measured root footprint and unchanged root depth, plus independently traced visible wood: trunk, exposed fork and large branches. Foliage canopy and empty gaps remain passable; no whole-canopy collision.

tree_4.note: Original measured root footprint and unchanged root depth, plus independently traced visible wood: trunk, exposed fork and large branches. Foliage canopy and empty gaps remain passable; no whole-canopy collision.

tree_5.note: Original measured root footprint and unchanged root depth, plus independently traced visible wood: trunk, exposed fork and large branches. Foliage canopy and empty gaps remain passable; no whole-canopy collision.
